notes: Pre-registered before running (commit 2 of the PR): across-day reference law on fpp2::calls (164 weekdays x 169 five-minute slots) read nb1 (top/bottom decile 0.83, bottom 1.60); clumpingLaw said 'either' on 164 of 164 days, L1 (>= 99 nb1) fails, wrong-law answers 0 (<= 16 holds). Scoring code checked first on simulated NB1/NB2/Poisson tables only (nb1->nb1, nb2->nb2, poisson->unclear). Post hoc, labelled: within-day first differences d^2/(2m) 1.005 pooled over 27,552 pairs; across-day residual dispersion 1.34/2.18/3.25/5.17/8.02 at 5/15/30/60/120 min; lag-1 0.31: Poisson round a wandering rate, the confound named in the pre-registration. No engine change. Verification: node --test calls-law.test.mjs (2 pass), nb1.test.mjs (6 pass), run_venture_tests.py changepoint-detector ok (757 tests, 238 s); venture-preflight clean after the entry-guard fix; post front-matter, link and similarity checks clean.
